Tiresias looks at how each new screen of an app is made (without reading its text) and fixes what would be read badly: rows in pieces, empty decorations, repeated items and titles that are not headings. It tells you when it repairs something.
What Tiresias has repaired in each app, to see and undo it

Tiresias checks each new screen of an app and fixes what is badly made. Here is everything it has fixed; what you undo is not fixed again automatically. You can also ask it to check the screen you are on with the action «Check this screen and repair it» (Tiresias menu or a gesture).
Undo all repairs in all apps? Screens will be checked again when you open them.

Tiresias was closed when the recent apps were cleared. To stop it happening again: in Phone Master or Settings, App management, allow it to auto-start, and set Tiresias battery use to unrestricted; it is in the Tiresias setup assistant, step 5. If you can lock Tiresias in Recents, do it: depending on the model, with the padlock on its card, by long pressing it or by swiping it down. And to close apps, better one at a time than with clear all.
Addresses, phone numbers and codes in text

The actions menu offers to open web addresses, write to email addresses, call phone numbers and copy codes (such as one in a text message) written in the text, even when they are not links. They are recognised on the phone itself.
Keep Tiresias speech from being recorded

Apps that record or cast the screen and video calls that share sound do not pick up Tiresias speech or sounds. It matters with speech on the media volume (on the accessibility volume they are never picked up). Android 10 or later.
